LITTLE PORT WALTER TERMINAL HARVEST AREA TROLL FISHERY

The Little Port Walter Terminal Harvest Area (THA) commercial salmon troll fishery will open for the harvest of all salmon from 12:01 a.m., Monday, June 1, through 11:59 p.m., Tuesday, June 30, 2026, unless closed by emergency order. The Northern Southeast Regional Aquaculture Association is forecasting a total run of approximately 1,100 hatcheryproduced Chinook salmon for the Little Port Walter THA.

The Little Port Walter THA (statistical area 109-10) consists of the waters of Port Walter and Little Port Walter, west of a line from 56°24.14' N lat, 134° 38.05' W long to 56°23.14' N lat, 134° 38.01' W long.

Beginning 12:0 a.m., Wednesday, July 1, 2026, the waters of Little Port Walter south and west of a line from 56°23.14' N lat, 134°38.01' W long to 56°23.36' N lat, 134°38.35' W long to 56°23.26' N lat, 134°38.64' W long are closed to troll gear. The waters of Port Walter will remain open to common property commercial troll fisheries through September 20, unless closed by emergency order.

Chinook salmon retention is permitted in the THA during the spring troll fishery from June 1 through June 30. Beginning at 12:01 a.m., July 1, Chinook salmon may be retained and possessed in the waters of Port Walter only during open Chinook salmon retention periods established for the summer troll fishery under 5 AAC 29.100(c).

The Emergency Order corresponding to this announcement is EO 1E0326.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
